description: This file defines the class 'du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng', which manages aperiodic SRS resources in a DU (Distributed Unit) for a wireless communication system. It includes methods for resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration specific to SRS resources, as well as internal structures for managing cell-specific contexts.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng
classes.description: Manages aperiodic SRS resources for a DU, including resource allocation and configuration.

classes.name: cell_context
classes.description: Holds cell-specific SRS resource configurations and state within the manager.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates an SRS resource to a cell group configuration based on policy.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources from a cell group configuration.

methods.name: get_nof_srs_free_res_offsets
methods.description: Returns the number of free SRS resource offsets, always maximum for aperiodic SRS.
